summary: An unconscious white male, possibly in his late 20s, was found at the bottom of an estimated 150-foot ravine near the 2400 block of Fourmile Canyon; he carried no identification and no associated vehicle or bicycle was found nearby.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Fourmile Fire Protection District; Boulder Emergency Squad; American Medical Response
notes: Seriously injured; airlifted by Northern Colorado MedEvac to Denver Health Hospital. Cause of the fall / why he was unconscious was unknown at publication. Year pinned by story-ID sequence (1138 predates the Sep-2014 ID 1951); 'the next day' after the Aug-17 item.
